title: ScanDesk — Private QR & Barcode
short_description: Fast, private, offline-first QR & barcode scanner and generator.
full_description:
ScanDesk is a fast, secure, and completely private QR and barcode utility suite.

Features:
- Live camera scanning with torch and camera switch
- Image & screenshot drag-and-drop scanner
- Smart parsing: Wi-Fi, Contacts, URLs, Products, SMS, Emails
- QR Code Studio with automated verification loop
- Continuous batch scanning with instant CSV/JSON export
- Local encrypted history storage with zero telemetry
- 100% offline operation without ads or trackers.
